method: Real wall-clock reading/aiming pauses, followed by the public application act() API. No clock acceleration. This is not a human usability trial or physical-controller timing.
entryExcluded: Timing begins after the immersive session is active; headset/browser permission time is excluded and belongs in physical QA.

final.instruction: Get to know your neighbours before you need them.

samples.instruction: Settle in. Touch the green tag to begin.
Lift the lid of your Blackout Communication Kit.
Stick an interest token into the first circle.
Touch the Blob to meet its volunteer operators.
Turn the page. Find a shared interest.
A neighbour asks to read more. Accept their request.
Draw a symbol for the neighbourhood garden.
People, places and paper. Your neighbourhood is connected.
